text: BAM share was unchanged over 21 hours and rose 0.06 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 34.2% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Current leadership changes should be read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
